Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL1267250. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1267250, exact-match standard_relation '=', and non-null standard_value. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
